name: read_resource
description: Read local text, list a directory, view an image, or open a complete file.

location.description: Absolute host path, local file URI, or `result.uri` from an earlier read. Omit to list the startup directory.

view.description: The default view previews local media and suggests a view.

anyOf.description: Read a window. Offsets and limits count UTF-8 bytes for text and entries for directory listings.

limit.description: Requested page size. Omit to let the reader choose.

metadata.description: Include modification times and regular-file sizes in directory listings when available.

anyOf.description: Use `image` for a local image, an HTTP(S) image URL, or a local file containing an image URL. The `file` view sends the entire local file to the model service for parsing, which may incur a charge.
